name: HorizontalScrollList
description: Polymorphic finite horizontal list with native scrolling, hidden scrollbars, item snapping, and a shared controller hook for paging controls.

as.description: Semantic element rendered for the list, commonly div, ul, or ol.

enabled.description: Applies the horizontal scrolling behavior and default keyboard focusability.

surface.description: Selects a transparent square rail over the caller background or a plain rail. Both surfaces use 8px item and edge spacing on mobile.

children.description: List items. Callers own item width and scroll-snap alignment.

nativeScrolling.note: Finite rails use native horizontal scrolling; callers do not translate the list with transforms.

itemGeometry.note: The list owns scrolling while callers own item width, gap, and edge padding.

accessibility.notes: Enabled lists default to tabIndex=0. Callers must provide an accessible label and semantic list items.
